title: release r27: add 104 hazards from five in-force duty-dense regulations
head: data-verify-batch-003
body:
## Summary

- Ingested clean-text clauses from five verified in-force regulations: 工贸企业重大事故隐患判定标准, 工贸企业粉尘防爆安全规定, 生产安全事故应急预案管理办法, 危险化学品重大危险源监督管理暂行规定, 工贸企业有限空间作业安全规定.
- 218 candidates reviewed title-by-title in the main session: 110 approved, 104 new after title-dedup; 108 dropped (regulator duties, fragments, list bodies, existing duplicates).
- Removed 18 duplicate unlinked clause records from double-imported laws.
- Gate six-phase PASS (1627 / 2006, strictBlockers=0), audit PASS, bundle verify clean; site-selection -> r27.
